fields.label: Calculate Payroll Working Days Based On

fields.description: If enabled, total no. of working days will include holidays, and this will reduce the value of Salary Per Day
fields.label: Include holidays in Total no. of Working Days

fields.description: If checked, hides and disables Rounded Total field in Salary Slips
fields.label: Disable Rounded Total

fields.description: The fraction of daily wages to be paid for half-day attendance
fields.label: Fraction of Daily Salary for Half Day

fields.description: Emails salary slip to employee based on preferred email selected in Employee
fields.label: Email Salary Slip to Employee

fields.description: The salary slip emailed to the employee will be password protected, the password will be generated based on the password policy.
fields.label: Encrypt Salary Slips in Emails

fields.description:
Example: SAL-{first_name}-{date_of_birth.year}
This will generate a password like SAL-Jane-1972
fields.label: Password Policy
Show Leave Balances in Salary Slip

fields.description: If checked, Payroll Payable will be booked against each employee
fields.label: Process Payroll Accounting Entry based on Employee

fields.description: If enabled, deducts payment days for absent attendance on holidays. By default, holidays are considered as paid
fields.label: Consider Marked Attendance on Holidays

fields.description: If enabled, a holiday or weekly off that is surrounded by absence is itself treated as unpaid and deducted from Payment Days (shown on the Salary Slip as Sandwich Days). Company policy, not statute — keep it documented in your leave policy before switching it on. Leave balances are not affected, only pay.
fields.label: Apply Sandwich Rule

fields.description: What counts as the absence on either side. Unpaid Absence Only — marked Absent, unmarked-as-Absent, or leave without pay / partially paid leave. Any Leave or Absence — approved paid leave counts too (the stricter reading; check it against your standing orders).
fields.label: Absence That Triggers It
fields.options:
Unpaid Absence Only
Any Leave or Absence

fields.description: Both Sides — the holiday is unpaid only if the employee was absent both before and after it (the usual rule). Either Side — absence on one side is enough.
fields.label: Absence Required On

fields.description: Which holidays can be sandwiched. Weekly Offs Only spares festival and national holidays — the safer default, since National & Festival Holidays Acts require those to be paid. Relies on the Weekly Off checkbox in the employee's Holiday List — a list whose Sundays were added by hand, without that flag, will be treated as ordinary holidays.
fields.label: Apply To
fields.options:
Weekly Offs Only
Weekly Offs and Holidays

fields.description: Caps how many days a single run of back-to-back holidays can cost. 0 means no cap. Set 2 to dock at most a weekend even when a long festival block is sandwiched.
fields.label: Max Sandwiched Days per Block
